truth_evidence: Affected every release before 2.11.3; fixed in 2.11.3 (ReDoS in the urlize punctuation regex).
Fix commit 15ef8f0, the merge of PR #1343 'backport urlize speedup', in tag 2.11.3 and not in 2.11.2. https://github.com/pallets/jinja/pull/1343
Module level in src/jinja2/utils.py: the _punctuation_re regex (the vulnerable pattern) and its neighbours _word_split_re, _simple_email_re, _letters, _digits are removed.
urlize: rewritten to match leading and trailing punctuation with anchored, non-backtracking patterns.
Entry points: urlize itself (public), and jinja2.filters.do_urlize, which calls it for the urlize template filter.

This function is a template filter. Templates reach it through the filter table (jinja2.filters.FILTERS), not through a Python call, so a project that uses the filter in a template has no Python call to it. Python-level call analysis cannot see template usage; the scan side must not report not_found on the strength of Python calls alone for filter advisories.
